g.text: Services aren't architecture — the gluten-free surcharge
Modular monolith — domain modules, one deployable
Chapter 27 — a process boundary is not an architecture. Silicon Sandwiches: modular monolith; the surcharge is a design problem, not a reason to invent three deployables.

text.tspan: but you don't pay a network tax just because
you drew service boxes. One quantum, one DB.
